notes:
**Off-the-record chats, and Keen asks before it sends or deletes.** Keen 0.36.0 lets you take a chat off the record, shows you more of what happens when you confirm an action or delete a memory, moves chat to a newer default model, and lets you delete a single line of your profile.

## Off the record

- **Take a chat off the record** from its header. Later chats can't see it, and Keen forgets what it kept from it: its summary, the agent's notes and the links it made in your knowledge graph. If that may not have finished, Keen says so and lets you try again.
- **What stays.** What Keen already learned from the chat stays until you remove it, the chat stays in your own history and search, your AI provider still receives every message, and earlier backups keep what they hold. It can't be undone, and the dialog lists all of this before you agree.

## Keen asks first

- **In chat, Keen asks before it sends an email or deletes** a task, project, milestone, knowledge item or calendar event. Most adds and edits still just happen. Turn those deletes off in Settings › AI Assistant.
- **A workflow waits for you** before it overwrites anything. Settings › Workflows marks one that needs approval.

## Memory

- **Delete one line of your profile.** In Settings › AI Assistant, User Profile reads line by line. Delete a line and choose any nearby beliefs to archive with it. Past chats still contain what was said.
- **See the agent's notes.** Session Notes, in the same section, lists the notes the agent keeps, and you can delete any of them.
- **Deleting a chat says what stays.** It removes the chat and what Keen kept from it. What Keen already learned from it, files you attached while it was on the record (they stay in your library) and earlier backups stay, and deleted text can remain in Keen's own files on disk.

## A newer default model

- **Chat now uses Claude Sonnet 5.5 by default.** A model you picked in Settings › AI Assistant › Models stays, and a server set up with its own model keeps it.

## Also

- **Sources searched.** An answer that searched the web lists the pages under "Sources searched".
- **Times in chat.** Messages show when they were sent, and the thread shows each day.

---

**Self-hosted servers: update yours.** This version of Keen needs a server at 0.36.0 or newer. A self-hosted server below that is blocked until it is updated: follow "Update to a new backend version" in the Self-Hosting Runbook, which uses `./scripts/update-remote.sh`.

**Backups made before 0.36.0 can't be restored in it.** Keen refuses them and leaves your data as it was. They stay on disk, and a later update will restore them again. Backups Keen makes from 0.36.0 on restore as usual.

**Updating:** Keen updates itself. You'll be prompted on next launch, or check Settings → Updates.

**Managed servers:** this release updates the backend too. If you're on a managed server, Keen will ask you to update it after the app restarts; that takes about a minute.
